q: What is the difference between open weights and open source?
options: Open weights publish parameters; open source also implies open code, data or permissive terms
Open weights are always free to use for any purpose
explain: Check licenses: open weights can carry restrictions.

q: What does “open weights” usually not include?
options: Training data and full training code
explain: Open weights differ from fully open.

q: What should you check before shipping an open model?
Why do teams choose open weights?
options: Data control, customization, offline use and cost at high volume
explain: Trade-off: you run serving and safety.
